title: DF Tag Viewer
description: Hold down a keybind to view DiamondFire item custom tags.
body:
# DF Tag Viewer
A simple Fabric 1.21.8 mod that allows viewing DiamondFire item custom tags by holding down a configureable keybind.

The goal is to act as a quick and simple replacement for that specific functionality in other DiamondFire client-side mods while they are still updating to 1.21.8 (all the way from 1.21.1/3!)
